meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: Claude 会用 BGPT 搜索科学论文,并返回从论文全文提取的结构化实验数据。每篇论文包含方法、结果、样本量、质量评分、结论等 25 个以上字段。
howto.when: 在已配置 BGPT 的 Claude 中,当你要求搜索科学论文、做文献综述/证据汇总,或想查摘要之外的实验细节时,它会返回结构化论文数据。

say.text: 帮我搜一下 CRISPR 基因编辑效率的人类细胞论文。
say.note: 会触发 BGPT 检索,返回含方法与结果等字段的论文数据。

say.text: 找 5 篇精神分裂症 GWAS 论文,提取样本量和效应量。
say.note: 会按论文返回可比对的定量数据,便于做证据汇总。

say.text: 查低碳水饮食随机对照试验,列出质量评分和结论。
say.note: 返回每篇的完整字段,可直接用于制作证据表。

howto.what_en: Claude searches scientific papers via BGPT and returns structured experimental data extracted from full text, with 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to search scientific papers, do a literature review/evidence synthesis, or look for experimental details beyond abstracts.

say_en.text: Search for papers about CRISPR gene editing efficiency in human cells.
say_en.note: Runs a BGPT search; returns method and result fields.

say_en.text: Find 5 schizophrenia GWAS papers and extract sample sizes and effect sizes.
say_en.note: Returns comparable per-paper data for evidence synthesis.

say_en.text: Find randomized controlled trials on low-carb diets and list quality scores and conclusions.
say_en.note: Returns full fields per paper for evidence tables.
